# jenkins_credentials (Data Source)

Lists the IDs of the credentials in a Jenkins credential store domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jenkins_credentials" "global" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) The domain within the credential store. Defaults to the global domain.
- `folder` (String) The folder whose credential store is read. If not set, the global store is used.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Set of String) The IDs of the credentials in the store domain.
- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source, derived from the folder and domain.
